description: This file defines a static helper class 'PdfFileHelper' for processing PDF content streams, extracting font information, glyph indices, and content streams from PDF pages within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: PdfFileHelper
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to extract and analyze content streams and font information from PDF documents.

methods.name: GetPageContentStream
methods.description: Retrieves the content stream of a specified page in a PDF document as a string.

methods.name: GetPageContentStreamEnumerator
methods.description: Creates an enumerator to inspect elements inside a page's content stream.

methods.name: GetHexStringAsGlyphIndices
methods.description: Converts a hex string into a sequence of glyph indices, splitting into 4-hex-digit chunks.

methods.name: TryParseDouble
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a double using invariant culture.

methods.name: GetCurrentFontName
methods.description: Determines the font name used for a specific text segment within a PDF page's content stream.
